<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="th">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>TECH QUEST - Minimal Adventure</title>
<style>

@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Noto+Sans+Thai:wght@300;400;500;600;700;800&display=swap');
:root{
 --bg:#f6f5fb;--surface:#fff;--surface-soft:#f1eff9;--surface-tint:#f8f7fc;
 --text:#29263d;--muted:#77748b;--border:#e7e4f0;--primary:#7668df;
 --primary-dark:#5e50c5;--primary-soft:#eeebff;--accent:#a69af6;
 --success:#16835d;--success-soft:#e7f6ef;--danger:#d4516b;--danger-soft:#fff0f2;
 --shadow:0 14px 38px rgba(48,40,88,.08);--radius:22px;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{margin:0;min-height:100vh;background:radial-gradient(circle at 12% 0%,#efedff 0,transparent 28%),var(--bg);color:var(--text);font-family:"Noto Sans Thai","Noto Sans",Tahoma,sans-serif;line-height:1.55}
button,input,select{font:inherit}
button{cursor:pointer;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:13px;padding:11px 16px;background:var(--surface);color:var(--text);font-weight:600;transition:transform .18s ease,box-shadow .18s ease,background .18s ease,border-color .18s ease}
button:hover:not(:disabled){transform:translateY(-1px);border-color:#c9c2ed;box-shadow:0 7px 18px rgba(74,62,145,.09)}
button:focus-visible,input:focus-visible,select:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #a79df0;outline-offset:2px}
button:disabled{opacity:.48;cursor:not-allowed;transform:none;box-shadow:none}
input,select{padding:12px 14px;background:#fff;color:var(--text);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:12px;max-width:100%;width:100%}
input::placeholder{color:#a29eb2}
.container{max-width:1080px;margin:0 auto;padding:22px}
h1,h2,h3,p{margin-top:0}
h1{font-size:clamp(27px,4vw,38px);font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.6px;color:var(--text);text-align:center}
h2{font-size:clamp(20px,3vw,25px);font-weight:750;color:var(--text);margin-bottom:14px}
h3{font-size:17px;color:var(--text)}
.screen{display:none}
.screen.active{display:block}
.card{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:var(--radius);padding:clamp(18px,3vw,28px);margin:16px 0;box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.hidden{display:none!important}
.muted,.codex-note,.knowledge-muted{color:var(--muted)}
.grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(170px,1fr));gap:13px}
.stat{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:4px;min-height:92px;padding:16px;background:var(--surface-tint);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:16px;text-align:center;color:var(--muted);font-size:13px}
button.stat{width:100%}
.stat b{display:block;color:var(--primary-dark);font-size:23px;font-weight:800}
.main{background:var(--primary);color:#fff;border-color:var(--primary);font-weight:700}
.main:hover:not(:disabled){background:var(--primary-dark);border-color:var(--primary-dark)}
.gold{background:var(--primary-soft);color:var(--primary-dark);border-color:#ded9ff;font-weight:700}
.gold:hover:not(:disabled){background:#e5e0ff;border-color:#c9c0ff}
.correct{background:var(--success-soft)!important;color:#116746!important;border-color:#a8dec3!important}
.wrong{background:var(--danger-soft)!important;color:#a7354d!important;border-color:#f0b8c3!important}
.line-icon{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex:0 0 auto;width:20px;height:20px;vertical-align:middle;color:currentColor}
.line-icon svg{display:block;width:100%;height:100%;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.8;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}
.button-icon{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:9px}
.app-topbar{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:14px;padding:8px 2px 14px}
.brand-lockup{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px}
.brand-mark{width:42px;height:42px;border-radius:14px;background:var(--primary-soft);color:var(--primary);display:grid;place-items:center}
.brand-mark .line-icon{width:24px;height:24px}
.brand-copy{display:flex;flex-direction:column;line-height:1.2}
.brand-copy strong{font-size:16px;letter-spacing:1.2px}
.brand-copy small{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);letter-spacing:.5px}
.top-actions{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.top-actions button{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.auth-logout{background:#fff;color:#6559b8;border-color:#dcd7f0}
.hero-wrap{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:25px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:4px 0 20px}
.hero-wrap>div{max-width:440px}
.hero-art{width:174px;max-height:220px;object-fit:contain;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:18px;background:#f0eff8;box-shadow:0 10px 25px rgba(45,37,90,.1)}
.home-actions{display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:center;gap:9px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:20px}
.home-actions button,.home-actions .backup-label{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.backup-label{padding:10px 14px;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:13px;background:var(--surface);font-weight:600;color:var(--text);cursor:pointer}
.backup-label input{width:auto;max-width:180px;border:0;padding:2px;background:transparent}
#saveStatus{margin:16px 0 0;font-size:12px}
.tower-banner{display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:center;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;padding:15px 18px;margin:14px 0 20px;background:var(--surface-soft);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:16px;color:var(--primary-dark);font-weight:650}
.tower-banner .line-icon{color:var(--primary)}
.map-form{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:12px;margin:18px 0}
.map-field{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;font-size:13px;font-weight:650;color:var(--muted)}
.map-field input,.map-field select{font-weight:400;color:var(--text)}
#difficultyProgress{grid-column:1/-1;margin:0}
#stages{margin-top:18px}
.stage-card{align-items:flex-start;text-align:left;min-height:142px;gap:8px;padding:15px}
.stage-card b{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;color:var(--primary-dark);font-size:15px}
.stage-card .stage-enemy-label,.stage-card .stage-state{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font-size:12px;color:var(--muted)}
.stage-card .stage-state{margin-top:auto;color:var(--primary-dark);font-weight:700}
#game{padding:clamp(16px,3vw,26px)}
.game-hud{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:14px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:12px}
.stage-meta{display:flex;flex-direction:column;min-width:0}
.stage-meta small{color:var(--muted);font-size:11px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.7px}
#stageTitle{font-weight:750;font-size:16px}
.game-stats{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center}
.hud-chip{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;padding:8px 12px;background:var(--surface-soft);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:12px;font-size:13px;color:var(--muted)}
.hud-chip b{color:var(--text);font-size:16px}
#time{min-width:20px;text-align:center}
.bar{height:9px;background:#eceaf3;border-radius:99px;overflow:hidden}
.bar div{height:100%;width:100%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#9d91f0,var(--primary));border-radius:99px;transition:width .3s ease}
#timebar{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#9e92f1,#7668df)}
#progress{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);margin:12px 0 5px}
.hp-display{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin:8px 0 14px;color:var(--muted);font-size:12px}
.hp-pips{display:flex;gap:5px}
.hp-pip{width:23px;height:8px;border-radius:20px;background:#e7e4ef}
.hp-pip.filled{background:#8c7fe8}
.hp-count{font-weight:700;color:var(--text)}
.battle-panel{padding:16px 18px;margin:12px 0 16px;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:18px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#faf9ff,#f0eef9)}
.battle-stage{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:clamp(12px,4vw,42px);min-height:176px}
.actor{position:relative;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:5px;min-width:115px;transition:transform .2s ease}
.actor-sprite-frame{position:relative;display:grid;place-items:center;width:126px;height:132px;overflow:visible}
.actor-sprite-frame img{display:block;max-width:100%;max-height:100%;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:contain;image-rendering:pixelated;filter:drop-shadow(0 8px 8px rgba(50,43,91,.16))}
.actor-player .actor-sprite-frame{border-radius:18px}
.actor-name{font-size:12px;font-weight:700;color:var(--text);text-align:center}
.battle-vs{width:34px;height:34px;display:grid;place-items:center;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--border);color:var(--muted);font-size:10px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.5px}
.actor-idle .actor-sprite-frame{animation:idleFloat 2.4s ease-in-out infinite}
.actor-walk.actor-player{animation:walkPlayer .85s ease-in-out 1}
.actor-walk.actor-enemy{animation:walkEnemy .85s ease-in-out 1}
.actor-walk .actor-sprite-frame{animation:walkBounce .85s ease-in-out 1}
.actor-attack.actor-player .actor-sprite-frame{animation:attackPlayer .56s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1) 1}
.actor-attack.actor-enemy .actor-sprite-frame{animation:attackEnemy .56s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1) 1}
.actor-hurt .actor-sprite-frame{animation:actorHurt .48s ease-out 1}
.actor-attack::after{content:"";position:absolute;top:28px;right:-4px;width:48px;height:48px;border:3px solid transparent;border-top-color:#8e80ef;border-right-color:#8e80ef;border-radius:50%;opacity:0;transform:rotate(-35deg);animation:slashBurst .5s ease-out 1;pointer-events:none}
.actor-enemy.actor-attack::after{left:-4px;right:auto;transform:scaleX(-1) rotate(-35deg);border-top-color:#d77b91;border-right-color:#d77b91}
.actor-hurt{filter:saturate(.65)}
.enemy-health{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin-top:7px;font-size:11px;color:var(--muted)}
.enemy-health .bar{flex:1}
#enemyBar{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#df8ca1,#cf5876)!important}
#enemyDesc{text-align:center;font-size:12px;margin:5px 0 10px}
.skill-panel{background:var(--surface-tint);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:16px;padding:15px;margin:14px 0}
.skill-panel>strong{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;color:var(--text);margin:0 0 10px;font-size:14px}
.skill-panel button{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin:4px;padding:10px 12px;background:#fff}
.skill-panel button small{display:block;color:var(--muted);font-size:10px;font-weight:400}
.skill-label{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px}
.skill-panel button:disabled{opacity:.42}
#skillStatus{font-size:11px;margin:9px 3px 0}
#question{font-size:clamp(18px,2.7vw,23px);line-height:1.55;margin:18px 0;padding:17px 18px;border-radius:16px;background:var(--surface-soft);border:1px solid var(--border)}
#answers{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:9px}
.answer{display:block;width:100%;text-align:left;margin:0;padding:13px 15px;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:13px;line-height:1.5}
.answer:disabled{opacity:1;cursor:default}
#feedback{min-height:25px;margin:12px 2px;font-size:13px}
#next{margin:4px 6px 4px 0}
#result{text-align:center}
.result-symbol{width:76px;height:76px;display:grid;place-items:center;margin:0 auto 12px;border-radius:24px;background:var(--primary-soft);color:var(--primary)}
.result-symbol .line-icon{width:38px;height:38px}
#resultTitle{margin-bottom:8px}
#resultText{color:var(--muted)}
.perk-panel-title{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
#perkCountdown{font-size:24px;color:var(--primary-dark);font-weight:800}
.perk-option{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;width:100%;text-align:left;margin:8px 0;padding:13px 15px;border:1px solid var(--border);background:#fff}
.perk-option.selected{border-color:var(--primary);background:var(--primary-soft);box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #7668df16}
.perk-option .line-icon{color:var(--primary)}
.perk-option small{display:block;color:var(--muted);font-size:11px;font-weight:400}
table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;background:#fff;border-radius:14px;overflow:hidden}
td,th{padding:12px 14px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);text-align:left}
th{background:var(--surface-soft);color:var(--primary-dark);font-size:12px}
td{font-size:13px}
.codex-img{display:block;width:100%;height:auto;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:16px;margin:12px 0 20px;background:var(--surface-soft)}
.codex-note{font-size:13px}
.section-title{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;margin:18px 0 7px;color:var(--primary-dark)}
.section-title .line-icon{width:22px;height:22px}
.knowledge-toolbar{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px;margin:14px 0}
.search-wrap{position:relative}
.search-wrap>.line-icon{position:absolute;left:13px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);color:var(--muted)}
.search-wrap input{padding-left:42px}
.knowledge-card{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:15px;padding:15px;margin:10px 0}
.knowledge-card h3{margin:8px 0;color:var(--text)}
.knowledge-tag{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;background:var(--surface-soft);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:20px;padding:4px 9px;font-size:11px;color:var(--primary-dark)}
.knowledge-tag .line-icon{width:14px;height:14px}
.knowledge-answer{color:var(--success);font-weight:700}.wrong-answer{color:var(--danger);font-weight:600}
.knowledge-muted{font-size:12px}
.knowledge-actions{display:flex;gap:7px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:10px 0}
.knowledge-actions button{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;font-size:13px}
.auth-screen{max-width:980px;margin:18px auto;padding:0!important;overflow:hidden;background:#fff!important;color:var(--text)!important;border:1px solid var(--border)!important;border-radius:26px!important;box-shadow:0 22px 60px rgba(49,40,93,.12)}
.auth-layout{display:grid;grid-template-columns:.9fr 1.1fr;min-height:570px}
.auth-side{background:linear-gradient(145deg,#9185ed,#695bd1);color:#fff;padding:42px 34px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;align-items:center;text-align:center}
.auth-logo{width:82px;height:82px;border-radius:24px;background:#fff;color:var(--primary);display:grid;place-items:center;margin-bottom:18px;box-shadow:0 12px 28px #4034a533}
.auth-logo-mark{font-size:25px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:1px}
.auth-side h1{font-size:31px;letter-spacing:1.8px;margin:8px 0;color:#fff}
.auth-side p{color:#f0eeff;line-height:1.7;max-width:280px;font-size:14px}
.auth-side .auth-caption{margin-top:48px;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:2.5px;font-weight:700;color:#e7e3ff}
.auth-panel{padding:48px clamp(22px,5vw,64px);display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;background:#fcfbff}
.auth-panel h2{color:var(--text);font-size:28px;margin:0 0 8px}
.auth-sub{color:var(--muted);margin:0 0 24px;font-size:13px}
.auth-form{display:none}
.auth-form.active{display:block}
.auth-field{display:block;margin:13px 0;color:#55516c;font-size:12px;font-weight:700}
.auth-field input{width:100%;max-width:none;margin-top:7px;padding:13px 14px;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:11px;background:#fff;color:var(--text);outline:none}
.auth-field input:focus{border-color:var(--primary);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px #8172e51b}
.auth-submit{width:100%;border:0;border-radius:11px;padding:14px;background:var(--primary);color:#fff;font-weight:700;margin:12px 0 8px}
.auth-submit:hover{background:var(--primary-dark)}
.auth-switch{text-align:center;color:var(--muted);font-size:12px;margin:15px 0}
.auth-link{border:0;background:transparent;color:var(--primary-dark);padding:4px 6px;font-weight:800;box-shadow:none}
.auth-link:hover{background:var(--primary-soft);box-shadow:none}
.auth-message{min-height:22px;color:#b23c58;font-size:12px;margin:5px 0}
.auth-message.ok{color:var(--success)}
.auth-divider{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;color:#aaa6bb;font-size:11px;margin:18px 0}
.auth-divider:before,.auth-divider:after{content:"";height:1px;background:var(--border);flex:1}
.auth-note{font-size:10px;color:#9692a5;line-height:1.6;text-align:center;margin-top:20px}
.auth-active .container>.app-topbar{display:none!important}
.auth-active .container>.screen:not(#authScreen){display:none!important}
.auth-active #authScreen{display:block!important}
@keyframes idleFloat{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)}50%{transform:translateY(-5px)}}
@keyframes walkBounce{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)}25%{transform:translateY(-6px) rotate(-2deg)}50%{transform:translateY(0) rotate(1deg)}75%{transform:translateY(-4px) rotate(-1deg)}}
@keyframes walkPlayer{0%{transform:translateX(-10px)}50%{transform:translateX(9px)}100%{transform:translateX(0)}}
@keyframes walkEnemy{0%{transform:translateX(10px)}50%{transform:translateX(-9px)}100%{transform:translateX(0)}}
@keyframes attackPlayer{0%{transform:translateX(0) rotate(0)}35%{transform:translateX(25px) rotate(-7deg) scale(1.05)}65%{transform:translateX(12px) rotate(4deg)}100%{transform:translateX(0) rotate(0)}}
@keyframes attackEnemy{0%{transform:translateX(0) rotate(0)}35%{transform:translateX(-25px) rotate(7deg) scale(1.05)}65%{transform:translateX(-12px) rotate(-4deg)}100%{transform:translateX(0) rotate(0)}}
@keyframes actorHurt{0%,100%{transform:translateX(0);filter:none}20%{transform:translateX(-7px);filter:brightness(1.25) saturate(.6)}40%{transform:translateX(6px)}60%{transform:translateX(-4px);filter:brightness(1.18)}80%{transform:translateX(3px)}}
@keyframes slashBurst{0%{opacity:0;transform:scale(.5) rotate(-35deg)}35%{opacity:.95;transform:scale(1.15) rotate(5deg)}100%{opacity:0;transform:scale(1.45) rotate(35deg)}}
@media(max-width:680px){
 .container{padding:12px}
 .auth-layout{grid-template-columns:1fr;min-height:0}
 .auth-side{padding:26px 20px}
 .auth-side .auth-caption{margin-top:12px}
 .auth-logo{width:64px;height:64px;margin-bottom:8px}
 .auth-side h1{font-size:25px}
 .auth-panel{padding:30px 22px}
 .auth-screen{margin:8px auto}
 .map-form{grid-template-columns:1fr}
 .knowledge-toolbar{grid-template-columns:1fr}
 .battle-stage{min-height:150px;gap:8px}
 .actor{min-width:95px}
 .actor-sprite-frame{width:105px;height:115px}
}
@media(max-width:480px){
 .container{padding:9px}
 .card{padding:15px;border-radius:18px}
 .app-topbar{align-items:flex-start}
 .brand-mark{width:37px;height:37px}
 .brand-copy strong{font-size:14px}
 .top-actions{gap:5px}
 .top-actions button{padding:9px 10px;font-size:12px}
 .hero-art{width:135px;max-height:175px}
 .hero-wrap{gap:12px}
 .home-actions{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
 .home-actions button,.home-actions .backup-label{justify-content:center;font-size:12px;padding:10px 8px}
 .backup-label{flex-wrap:wrap}
 .backup-label input{max-width:100px}
 #answers{grid-template-columns:1fr}
 .game-hud{align-items:flex-start}
 .game-stats{width:100%;justify-content:flex-end}
 .battle-panel{padding:12px 8px}
 .actor-sprite-frame{width:90px;height:100px}
 .actor{min-width:82px}
 .battle-vs{width:29px;height:29px}
 .skill-panel button{width:100%;justify-content:flex-start;margin:4px 0}
 td,th{padding:9px 7px;font-size:11px}
}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
 *,*::before,*::after{scroll-behavior:auto!important;animation-duration:.01ms!important;animation-iteration-count:1!important;transition-duration:.01ms!important}
}

</style>
</head>
<body>
<div class="container">


<section id="authScreen" class="screen auth-screen">
 <div class="auth-layout">
  <aside class="auth-side">
   <div class="auth-logo"><span class="auth-logo-mark">TQ</span></div>
   <h1>TECH QUEST</h1>
   <p>ยินดีต้อนรับสู่โลกแห่งการผจญภัย เรียนรู้เทคโนโลยีและพิชิตหอคอยแห่งความรู้</p>
   <div class="auth-caption">LOGIN · SIGN UP</div>
  </aside>
  <div class="auth-panel">
   <form id="loginForm" class="auth-form active" onsubmit="event.preventDefault();loginAccount()">
    <h2>เข้าสู่ระบบ</h2>
    <p class="auth-sub">กลับมาผจญภัยต่อใน TECH QUEST</p>
    <label class="auth-field">อีเมลหรือชื่อบัญชี
     <input id="loginIdentity" type="text" autocomplete="username" placeholder="กรอกอีเมลหรือชื่อบัญชี" required>
    </label>
    <label class="auth-field">รหัสผ่าน
     <input id="loginPassword" type="password" autocomplete="current-password" placeholder="กรอกรหัสผ่าน" required>
    </label>
    <div id="loginMessage" class="auth-message" aria-live="polite"></div>
    <button class="auth-submit" type="submit">เข้าสู่ระบบ</button>
    <p class="auth-switch">ยังไม่มีบัญชี? <button class="auth-link" type="button" onclick="switchAuth('signup')">สมัครบัญชี</button></p>
   </form>
   <form id="signupForm" class="auth-form" onsubmit="event.preventDefault();registerAccount()">
    <h2>สร้างบัญชีใหม่</h2>
    <p class="auth-sub">สมัครสมาชิกเพื่อเริ่มต้นการผจญภัย</p>
    <label class="auth-field">ชื่อผู้เล่น
     <input id="signupName" type="text" maxlength="18" autocomplete="nickname" placeholder="ชื่อที่ใช้ในเกม" required>
    </label>
    <label class="auth-field">อีเมล
     <input id="signupEmail" type="email" autocomplete="email" placeholder="name@example.com" required>
    </label>
    <label class="auth-field">รหัสผ่าน
     <input id="signupPassword" type="password" minlength="6" autocomplete="new-password" placeholder="อย่างน้อย 6 ตัวอักษร" required>
    </label>
    <label class="auth-field">ยืนยันรหัสผ่าน
     <input id="signupConfirm" type="password" minlength="6" autocomplete="new-password" placeholder="กรอกรหัสผ่านอีกครั้ง" required>
    </label>
    <div id="signupMessage" class="auth-message" aria-live="polite"></div>
    <button class="auth-submit" type="submit">สมัครบัญชี</button>
    <p class="auth-switch">มีบัญชีอยู่แล้ว? <button class="auth-link" type="button" onclick="switchAuth('login')">เข้าสู่ระบบ</button></p>
   </form>
   <p class="auth-note">บัญชีรุ่นทดลองนี้จัดเก็บไว้ในเบราว์เซอร์เครื่องนี้ ยังไม่ใช่ระบบสมาชิกออนไลน์</p>
  </div>
 </div>
</section>

 <div class="grid">

   <option value="ทั้งหมด">ทุกหมวดหมู่</option>

   <option value="การเขียนโปรแกรม">การเขียนโปรแกรม</option>

<script>

const ICON_PATHS={
 code:'<path d="m8 8-4 4 4 4M16 8l4 4-4 4M14 5l-4 14"/>',
 trophy:'<path d="M8 21h8M12 17v4M7 4h10v5a5 5 0 0 1-10 0V4Z"/><path d="M7 6H4v2a4 4 0 0 0 4 4M17 6h3v2a4 4 0 0 1-4 4"/>',
 tower:'<path d="M4 21h16M6 21V8h12v13M8 8V4h8v4M10 12h4M10 16h4"/>',
 book:'<path d="M4 5.5A2.5 2.5 0 0 1 6.5 3H20v17H6.5A2.5 2.5 0 0 0 4 22V5.5Z"/><path d="M4 18a2.5 2.5 0 0 1 2.5-2.5H20"/>',
 save:'<path d="M5 3h12l4 4v14H3V3h2Z"/><path d="M7 3v6h10V3M7 21v-8h10v8"/>',
 download:'<path d="M12 3v12m0 0 4-4m-4 4-4-4M4 19v2h16v-2"/>',
 upload:'<path d="M12 16V4m0 0 4 4m-4-4L8 8M4 17v4h16v-4"/>',
 clock:'<circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9"/><path d="M12 7v5l3 2"/>',
 search:'<circle cx="10.8" cy="10.8" r="6.8"/><path d="m16 16 4.5 4.5"/>',
 scan:'<path d="M4 8V4h4M16 4h4v4M20 16v4h-4M8 20H4v-4"/><path d="M7 12h10"/>',
 zap:'<path d="m13 2-9 12h7l-1 8 10-13h-7l0-7Z"/>',
 heart:'<path d="M20.5 8.8c0 5-8.5 11-8.5 11s-8.5-6-8.5-11A4.5 4.5 0 0 1 12 6.2a4.5 4.5 0 0 1 8.5 2.6Z"/>',
 shield:'<path d="M12 3 20 6v5c0 5-3.4 8.2-8 10-4.6-1.8-8-5-8-10V6l8-3Z"/><path d="m9 12 2 2 4-4"/>',
 monitor:'<rect x="3" y="4" width="18" height="13" rx="2"/><path d="M8 21h8M12 17v4"/>',
 users:'<path d="M16 20v-1.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 0-3.5-3.5h-5A3.5 3.5 0 0 0 4 18.5V20"/><circle cx="10" cy="8" r="3.5"/><path d="M17 4.8a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 0 6.8M20 20v-1.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 0-2.5-3.35"/>',
 check:'<path d="m5 12 4 4L19 6"/>',
 lock:'<rect x="4" y="10" width="16" height="11" rx="2"/><path d="M8 10V7a4 4 0 0 1 8 0v3M12 14v3"/>',
 arrow:'<path d="M5 12h14m-6-6 6 6-6 6"/>',
 spark:'<path d="m12 3 1.8 5.2L19 10l-5.2 1.8L12 17l-1.8-5.2L5 10l5.2-1.8L12 3Z"/><path d="m19 15 .8 2.2L22 18l-2.2.8L19 21l-.8-2.2L16 18l2.2-.8L19 15Z"/>',
 brain:'<path d="M9 4a3 3 0 0 0-5 2.2A3.5 3.5 0 0 0 4 13a3.5 3.5 0 0 0 5 5"/><path d="M15 4a3 3 0 0 1 5 2.2A3.5 3.5 0 0 1 20 13a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-5 5"/><path d="M9 4v16M15 4v16M9 9H6M15 9h3M9 14H6M15 14h3"/>',
 crown:'<path d="m3 8 5 4 4-7 4 7 5-4-2 11H5L3 8Z"/><path d="M5 21h14"/>',
 user:'<circle cx="12" cy="8" r="4"/><path d="M4 21a8 8 0 0 1 16 0"/>',
 globe:'<circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9"/><path d="M3 12h18M12 3a14 14 0 0 1 0 18M12 3a14 14 0 0 0 0 18"/>',
 database:'<ellipse cx="12" cy="5" rx="8" ry="3"/><path d="M4 5v7c0 1.7 3.6 3 8 3s8-1.3 8-3V5M4 12v7c0 1.7 3.6 3 8 3s8-1.3 8-3v-7"/>'
};
function iconSvg(name,size=18){
 const path=ICON_PATHS[name]||ICON_PATHS.spark;
 return `<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="${size}" height="${size}" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false">${path}</svg>`;
}
function categoryIcon(category){
 return ({'คอมพิวเตอร์':'monitor','อินเทอร์เน็ต':'globe','ความปลอดภัยไซเบอร์':'shield','AI':'brain','การเขียนโปรแกรม':'code','เทคโนโลยีทั่วไป':'database'})[category]||'book';
}
function renderHP(){
 const total=Math.max(3,Number(maxLives)||3,Number(lives)||0);
 const filled=Math.max(0,Math.min(total,Number(lives)||0));
 return `<span>HP</span><span class="hp-pips">${Array.from({length:total},(_,i)=>`<i class="hp-pip ${i<filled?'filled':''}"></i>`).join('')}</span><strong class="hp-count">${filled}/${total}</strong>`;
}
function playActorAnimation(actorId,state,duration=700){
 const actor=document.getElementById(actorId);if(!actor)return;
 const states=['actor-idle','actor-walk','actor-attack','actor-hurt'];
 actor.classList.remove(...states);
 void actor.offsetWidth;
 actor.classList.add('actor-'+state);
 if(state!=='idle'){
  window.setTimeout(()=>{if(actor.classList.contains('actor-'+state)){actor.classList.remove('actor-'+state);actor.classList.add('actor-idle');}},duration);
 }
}

const rankNames=[
"Bronze","Silver","Gold","Platinum","Diamond",
"Emerald","Ruby","Master","Grandmaster","Cyber Legend"
];

const TOTAL_FLOORS=50;
const stages=Array.from({length:TOTAL_FLOORS},(_,i)=>{
 const floor=i+1, theme=baseStages[Math.floor(i/5)%baseStages.length];
 const boss=floor%5===0;
 const monster=monsterPool[i%monsterPool.length];
 const bossInfo=boss?bossPool[(floor/5)-1]:null;
 const floorQuestions=theme.questions.map((q,qi)=>{
  const labels=["ภารกิจทดสอบ","โจทย์วิเคราะห์","บททดสอบความเข้าใจ","ภารกิจภาคสนาม","ด่านท้าทาย","คำถามนักสำรวจ","แบบทดสอบพิเศษ","โจทย์ประจำด่าน","ภารกิจความรู้"];
  return [`ชั้น ${floor} • ${labels[qi%labels.length]}: ${q[0]}`,q[1],q[2]];
 });
 return {name:theme.name,icon:theme.icon,monster:boss?bossInfo:monster,isBoss:boss,questions:floorQuestions};
});

const SAVE_VERSION = 2;
const SAVE_KEYS = ["TECH_QUEST_SAVE_A", "TECH_QUEST_SAVE_B", "TECH_QUEST_BACKUP"];
let data = { name:"นักสำรวจ", xp:0, stars:0, unlocked:1, cleared:[], knowledge:[] };
let leaderboardData = [];
let saveNotice = "";

let currentStage=0,questions=[],index=0,score=0,correct=0,lives=3;
let skillUses={scan:0,boost:0,heal:0};
let scanActiveIndex=-1;
let timer=null,time=30,answered=false,lastChoice=null;
let correctAdvanceTimer=null,perkTimer=null,perkSeconds=35,selectedPerk=null,floorPerk=null,activeFloorPerk=null,maxLives=3;
let friendMode=false,friendPlayers=[],friendScores=[],friendTurn=0;
let previousScreen="home";

function checksum(value){
 const text=JSON.stringify(value); let hash=2166136261;
 for(let i=0;i<text.length;i++){hash^=text.charCodeAt(i);hash=Math.imul(hash,16777619);}
 return (hash>>>0).toString(16);
}
function validProfile(p){
 return !!p && typeof p.name==="string" && p.name.length<=18 &&
  Number.isSafeInteger(p.xp) && p.xp>=0 && Number.isSafeInteger(p.stars) && p.stars>=0 &&
  Number.isInteger(p.unlocked) && p.unlocked>=1 && p.unlocked<=stages.length &&
  Array.isArray(p.cleared) && p.cleared.every(n=>Number.isInteger(n)&&n>=0&&n<stages.length);
}
function makeSave(){
 const active=document.getElementById("game").classList.contains("active") && !friendMode;
 return {profile:{...data,cleared:[...data.cleared]}, leaderboard:leaderboardData,
  session:{active,stage:currentStage,questions:questions.map(q=>[q[0],[...q[1]],q[2]]),index,score,correct,lives,time,answered:!!answered,choice:lastChoice,skillUses:{...skillUses},scanActiveIndex,
   difficulty:document.getElementById("difficulty").value},
  meta:{savedAt:Date.now(),playerId:"local-player"}};
}
function validEnvelope(e){
 if(!e||e.version!==SAVE_VERSION||!e.data||e.checksum!==checksum(e.data)) return false;
 const d=e.data, s=d.session;
 if(!validProfile(d.profile)||!Array.isArray(d.leaderboard)) return false;
 if(!s||typeof s.active!=="boolean") return false;
 if(s.skillUses!==undefined && (!s.skillUses || typeof s.skillUses!=="object" || ["scan","boost","heal"].some(k=>!(typeof s.skillUses[k]==="boolean" || (Number.isInteger(s.skillUses[k])&&s.skillUses[k]>=0&&s.skillUses[k]<=2))))) return false;
 if(s.active && (!Number.isInteger(s.stage)||s.stage<0||s.stage>=stages.length||!Array.isArray(s.questions)||s.questions.length!==9||
  !s.questions.every(q=>Array.isArray(q)&&q.length===3&&typeof q[0]==="string"&&Array.isArray(q[1])&&q[1].length===4&&q[1].every(a=>typeof a==="string")&&Number.isInteger(q[2])&&q[2]>=0&&q[2]<4)||
  !Number.isInteger(s.index)||s.index<0||s.index>8||!Number.isFinite(s.score)||s.score<0||!Number.isInteger(s.correct)||s.correct<0||s.correct>9||
  !Number.isInteger(s.lives)||s.lives<0||s.lives>3||!Number.isFinite(s.time)||s.time<0||s.time>45||
  typeof s.answered!=="boolean"||!(s.choice===null||(Number.isInteger(s.choice)&&s.choice>=-1&&s.choice<4))||
  !["easy","normal","hard","expert"].includes(s.difficulty))) return false;
 return true;
}
function readSave(key){
 try{const raw=localStorage.getItem(key);if(!raw)return null;const e=JSON.parse(raw);return validEnvelope(e)?e:null;}catch{return null;}
}
function loadBestSave(){
 try{
  return SAVE_KEYS.map(key=>({key,envelope:readSave(key)}))
   .filter(x=>x.envelope)
   .sort((a,b)=>b.envelope.savedAt-a.envelope.savedAt)[0]||null;
 }catch{return null;}
}
function saveGame(){
 try{
  const payload=makeSave();
  if(!validProfile(payload.profile)) throw new Error("ข้อมูลผู้เล่นไม่ถูกต้อง");
  const previous=loadBestSave();
  const envelope={version:SAVE_VERSION,savedAt:Date.now(),data:payload,checksum:checksum(payload)};
  // เก็บชุดล่าสุดเดิมไว้เป็นข้อมูลสำรอง ก่อนเขียนชุดใหม่
  if(previous && previous.envelope){
   try{localStorage.setItem(SAVE_KEYS[2],JSON.stringify(previous.envelope));}catch(backupError){console.warn("สร้างข้อมูลสำรองไม่สำเร็จ",backupError);}
  }
  // สลับช่อง A/B เพื่อไม่เขียนทับชุดล่าสุดทุกครั้ง
  const target=previous && previous.key===SAVE_KEYS[0]?SAVE_KEYS[1]:SAVE_KEYS[0];
  localStorage.setItem(target,JSON.stringify(envelope));
  // ตรวจว่าข้อมูลที่เพิ่งเขียนสามารถอ่านกลับและตรวจ checksum ได้
  const verified=readSave(target);
  if(!verified || verified.savedAt!==envelope.savedAt) throw new Error("ตรวจสอบข้อมูลหลังบันทึกไม่ผ่าน");
  saveNotice="บันทึกอัตโนมัติแล้ว";
  const status=document.getElementById("saveStatus");
  if(status) status.textContent="บันทึกล่าสุด: "+new Date(envelope.savedAt).toLocaleTimeString("th-TH");
  return true;
 }catch(error){
  console.warn("บันทึกเกมไม่สำเร็จ",error);
  saveNotice="บันทึกไม่สำเร็จ";
  const status=document.getElementById("saveStatus");
  if(status) status.textContent="บันทึกไม่สำเร็จ กรุณาส่งออกไฟล์สำรอง";
  return false;
 }
}
function persist(){saveGame();}
function loadGame(){
 const found=loadBestSave(); if(!found)return false;
 const saved=found.envelope;
 const d=saved.data; data={...d.profile,cleared:[...d.profile.cleared],knowledge:Array.isArray(d.profile.knowledge)?d.profile.knowledge:[]};
 leaderboardData=Array.isArray(d.leaderboard)?d.leaderboard:[];
 if(d.session.active){
  const s=d.session; currentStage=s.stage; questions=s.questions; index=s.index; score=s.score; correct=s.correct; lives=s.lives;
  skillUses={scan:0,boost:0,heal:0,...(s.skillUses||{})};
  for(const k of ["scan","boost","heal"])skillUses[k]=typeof skillUses[k]==="boolean"?(skillUses[k]?1:0):Math.max(0,Math.min(2,skillUses[k]));
  scanActiveIndex=Number.isInteger(s.scanActiveIndex)?s.scanActiveIndex:-1;
  document.getElementById("difficulty").value=s.difficulty;
  restoreSessionTime=s.time;
  restoreSessionAnswered=s.answered;
  restoreSessionChoice=s.choice;
  answered=s.answered;
  lastChoice=s.choice;
 }
 return true;
}
let restoreSessionTime=null;
let restoreSessionAnswered=false;
let restoreSessionChoice=null;
window.addEventListener("pagehide",()=>{saveGame();});
window.addEventListener("beforeunload",()=>{saveGame();});
document.addEventListener("visibilitychange",()=>{if(document.visibilityState==="hidden")saveGame();});
// บันทึกสำรองเป็นระยะ เผื่อผู้ใช้ปิดแท็บหรือเบราว์เซอร์กะทันหัน
setInterval(()=>{saveGame();},10000);

function getDifficultyInfo(){
 const mode=document.getElementById("difficulty")?.value||"easy";
 const base={easy:45,normal:40,hard:35,expert:30}[mode]||45;
 const baseLevel={easy:1,normal:2,hard:3,expert:4}[mode]||1;
 const clearedCount=Math.min(TOTAL_FLOORS,data.cleared.length);
 const level=baseLevel+clearedCount;
 // ทุกชั้นที่เคลียร์สำเร็จจะเพิ่มระดับความยาก 1 ระดับ
 const seconds=Math.max(12,base-(clearedCount*0.65));
 const multiplier=({easy:1,normal:1.25,hard:1.6,expert:2}[mode]||1)*(1+clearedCount*0.04);
 return {mode,base,baseLevel,clearedCount,level,seconds,multiplier};
}
function updateDifficultyDisplay(){
 const el=document.getElementById("difficultyProgress");
 if(!el)return;
 const d=getDifficultyInfo();
 el.textContent=`ความยากปัจจุบัน: ระดับ ${d.level} • ผ่านแล้ว ${d.clearedCount} ชั้น • เวลาเริ่มต้นชั้นถัดไปประมาณ ${Math.ceil(d.seconds)} วินาที • ตัวคูณคะแนน x${d.multiplier.toFixed(2)}`;
}

function level(){
 let xp=data.xp,lv=1,need=100;
 while(xp>=need){
  xp-=need;
  lv++;
  need+=100;
 }
 return lv;
}

function rank(){
 let stars=data.stars,idx=0,need=100;
 while(idx<9&&stars>=need){
  stars-=need;
  idx++;
  need+=200;
 }
 return {idx,name:rankNames[idx],progress:stars,need};
}

function show(id){
 document.querySelectorAll(".screen").forEach(x=>x.classList.remove("active"));
 const target=document.getElementById(id);
 if(target)target.classList.add("active");
 document.body.classList.toggle("auth-active",id==="authScreen");
}

function homeScreen(){
 clearInterval(timer);
 friendMode=false;
 update();
 show("home");
}

function update(){
 document.getElementById("hlevel").textContent="Lv."+level();
 document.getElementById("hxp").textContent=data.xp;
 document.getElementById("hrank").textContent=rank().name;
 persist();
}

function mapScreen(){
 clearInterval(timer);clearTimeout(correctAdvanceTimer);clearInterval(perkTimer);
 update();
 show("map");
 document.getElementById("mlevel").textContent="Lv."+level();
 document.getElementById("mxp").textContent=data.xp;
 document.getElementById("mrank").textContent=rank().name;
 document.getElementById("playerName").value=data.name;
 updateDifficultyDisplay();

 document.getElementById("stages").innerHTML=stages.map((s,i)=>`
 <button class="stat stage-card" ${i>=data.unlocked?"disabled":""} onclick="startStage(${i})">
  <b>${iconSvg("tower",18)} ชั้น ${i+1} · ${s.name}</b>
  <span class="stage-enemy-label">${iconSvg(s.isBoss?"crown":"shield",15)} ${s.isBoss?"บอส":"ศัตรู"}: ${s.monster.name}</span>
  <span class="stage-state">${data.cleared.includes(i)?iconSvg("check",15)+" เคลียร์แล้ว":i>=data.unlocked?iconSvg("lock",15)+" ยังล็อก":iconSvg("arrow",15)+" ขึ้นชั้นนี้"}</span>
 </button>`).join("");
}

function bestiaryScreen(){
 clearInterval(timer);
 previousScreen=document.querySelector(".screen.active").id;
 show("bestiary");
}

function detail(type){
 previousScreen=document.querySelector(".screen.active").id;
 show("details");
 let content=document.getElementById("detailContent");

 if(type==="level"){
  let lv=level(),used=0,need=100;
  for(let i=1;i<lv;i++){used+=need;need+=100}
  content.innerHTML=`
  <h2>⭐ Lv.${lv}</h2>
  <p>XP สะสม ${data.xp}</p>
  <p>ความคืบหน้า ${data.xp-used}/${need} XP</p>
  <p>ต้องการอีก ${need-(data.xp-used)} XP เพื่อเลเวลถัดไป</p>`;
  document.getElementById("detailTitle").textContent="ระบบเลเวล";
 }else{
  let r=rank();
  content.innerHTML=`
  <h2>${r.name}</h2>
  <p>ดาวทั้งหมด ${data.stars} </p>
  <p>ความคืบหน้า ${r.progress}/${r.need} ดาว</p>
  <ol>${rankNames.map(n=>"<li>"+n+"</li>").join("")}</ol>`;
  document.getElementById("detailTitle").textContent="ระบบแรงก์";
 }

function backDetail(){
 show(previousScreen);
}

function startStage(i){
 data.name=document.getElementById("playerName").value.trim()||"นักสำรวจ";
 persist();
 friendMode=false;
 currentStage=i;
 beginTurn();
}

function getQuestions(){
 // ประวัติแยกตามหมวด: ใช้คำถามที่ยังไม่เคยออกก่อน จนครบคลังแล้วจึงเริ่มรอบใหม่
 const themeIndex=Math.floor(currentStage/5)%baseStages.length;
 const floorKey=`techQuestQuestionHistory_v2_theme_${themeIndex}`;
 const pool=[...stages[currentStage].questions];
 const questionId=q=>q[0].replace(/^ชั้น \d+ • [^:]+: /,'');
 const shuffle=a=>{for(let i=a.length-1;i>0;i--){const j=Math.floor(Math.random()*(i+1));[a[i],a[j]]=[a[j],a[i]];}return a;};
 let seen=[];
 try{seen=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(floorKey)||'[]');if(!Array.isArray(seen))seen=[];}catch{seen=[];}
 const unseen=pool.filter(q=>!seen.includes(questionId(q)));
 let source=unseen;
 // ถ้าคลังหมวดนี้ถูกใช้ครบแล้ว ให้เริ่มรอบใหม่จากคลังทั้งหมด
 if(source.length<9){source=pool;seen=[];}
 const selected=shuffle([...source]).slice(0,9);
 const nextSeen=[...new Set([...seen,...selected.map(questionId)])];
 try{localStorage.setItem(floorKey,JSON.stringify(nextSeen.length>=pool.length?[]:nextSeen));}catch{}
 return selected.map(q=>{
  let opts=shuffle(q[1].map((v,i)=>({v,correct:i===q[2]})));
  return [q[0],opts.map(o=>o.v),opts.findIndex(o=>o.correct)];
 });
}

function beginTurn(){
 questions=getQuestions();
 clearTimeout(correctAdvanceTimer); activeFloorPerk=floorPerk;floorPerk=null;index=0;score=0;correct=0;maxLives=activeFloorPerk==="vitality"?4:3;lives=maxLives;skillUses={scan:0,boost:0,heal:0};scanActiveIndex=-1;answered=false;lastChoice=null;restoreSessionAnswered=false;restoreSessionChoice=null;
 show("game");
 renderQuestion();
 playActorAnimation("playerActor","walk",900);
 playActorAnimation("enemyActor","walk",900);
}

function renderQuestion(){
 clearInterval(timer);
 playActorAnimation("playerActor","idle");playActorAnimation("enemyActor","idle");
 answered=false;
 lastChoice=null;
 const difficultyInfo=getDifficultyInfo();
 time=Math.max(12,Math.ceil(difficultyInfo.seconds))+(activeFloorPerk==="time"?10:0);
 if(restoreSessionTime!==null){time=Math.max(0,Math.min(time,restoreSessionTime));restoreSessionTime=null;}
 const floorData=stages[currentStage];
 const playerArt=document.getElementById("playerBattleArt");
 const homeArt=document.querySelector(".hero-art");
 if(playerArt&&homeArt)playerArt.src=homeArt.src;
 const playerLabel=document.getElementById("playerActorName");
 if(playerLabel)playerLabel.textContent=friendMode?friendPlayers[friendTurn]:(data.name||"Tech Hero");
 document.getElementById("stageTitle").textContent=
 (friendMode?friendPlayers[friendTurn]+" • ":"")+`ชั้น ${currentStage+1} • ความยาก Lv.${getDifficultyInfo().level} • `+floorData.name+(floorData.isBoss?" • BOSS":"");
 const enemyName=document.getElementById("enemyName"), enemyDesc=document.getElementById("enemyDesc");
 if(enemyName)enemyName.textContent=`${floorData.isBoss?"BOSS: ":"มอนสเตอร์: "}${floorData.monster.name}`;
 const enemyArt=document.getElementById("enemyArt"); if(enemyArt){enemyArt.src=floorData.monster.image||bossArt[0]; enemyArt.alt=(floorData.isBoss?"บอส ":"มอนสเตอร์ ")+floorData.monster.name;}
 if(enemyDesc)enemyDesc.textContent=floorData.isBoss?"ห้องบอสประจำทุก 5 ชั้น! ตอบคำถามให้ผ่านเพื่อพิชิตบอส":"ศัตรูประจำชั้นนี้ • ตอบคำถามเพื่อโจมตีและเอาชนะ";
 const enemyBar=document.getElementById("enemyBar"); if(enemyBar)enemyBar.style.width=Math.max(0,100-(index/9)*100)+"%";
 updateSkillButtons();
 document.getElementById("score").textContent=score;
 document.getElementById("time").textContent=time;
 document.getElementById("timebar").style.width="100%";
 document.getElementById("progress").textContent=`ข้อ ${index+1}/9`;
 document.getElementById("hp").innerHTML=renderHP();
 document.getElementById("question").textContent=questions[index][0];
 document.getElementById("feedback").textContent="เลือกคำตอบที่ถูกต้อง";
 document.getElementById("next").classList.add("hidden");

 document.getElementById("answers").innerHTML=questions[index][1].map((a,i)=>
 `<button class="answer" onclick="answer(${i})">${["A","B","C","D"][i]}. ${a}</button>`
 ).join("");
 if(scanActiveIndex===index){
  const correctIndex=questions[index][2];
  [...document.querySelectorAll(".answer")].filter((b,i)=>i!==correctIndex).slice(0,2).forEach(b=>{b.disabled=true;b.style.opacity=".3";b.textContent+=" — ตัดตัวเลือก";});
 }

 if(restoreSessionAnswered){
  answered=true;
  const buttons=[...document.querySelectorAll(".answer")];
  buttons.forEach((b,i)=>{b.disabled=true;if(i===questions[index][2])b.classList.add("correct");if(i===restoreSessionChoice&&i!==questions[index][2])b.classList.add("wrong");});
  document.getElementById("feedback").textContent="กู้คืนคำตอบที่บันทึกไว้แล้ว กดข้อต่อไปเพื่อเล่นต่อ";
  document.getElementById("next").classList.remove("hidden");
  document.getElementById("next").innerHTML=(lives===0||index===8)?iconSvg("check")+" ดูผลลัพธ์":iconSvg("arrow")+" ข้อต่อไป";
  restoreSessionAnswered=false; restoreSessionChoice=null;
  saveGame();
  return;
 }
 timer=setInterval(()=>{
  time--;
  document.getElementById("time").textContent=time;
  document.getElementById("timebar").style.width=(time/({easy:45,normal:40,hard:35,expert:30}[mode])*100)+"%";
  saveGame();
  if(time<=0)answer(-1);
 },1000);
 saveGame();
}

function updateSkillButtons(){
 const labels={scan:["scan","วิเคราะห์คำตอบ"],boost:["zap","เร่งเวลา +10 วิ"],heal:["heart","ฟื้นฟู HP +1"]};
 for(const key of Object.keys(labels)){
  const btn=document.getElementById(key==="scan"?"skillScan":key==="boost"?"skillBoost":"skillHeal");
  const used=skillUses[key]||0, remaining=Math.max(0,2-used);
  if(btn){
   btn.disabled=remaining===0||answered||(key==="heal"&&lives>=maxLives);
   btn.innerHTML=`<span class="skill-label">${iconSvg(labels[key][0])}<span>${labels[key][1]}</span></span><small>เหลือ ${remaining}/2 ครั้ง/ชั้น</small>`;
  }
 }
 const status=document.getElementById("skillStatus");if(status)status.textContent=`จำนวนครั้งที่ใช้: วิเคราะห์ ${skillUses.scan||0}/2 • เร่งเวลา ${skillUses.boost||0}/2 • ฟื้นฟู ${skillUses.heal||0}/2`;
}
function useSkill(type){
 if(answered||!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(skillUses,type)||(skillUses[type]||0)>=2)return;
 if(type==="scan"){
  const correctIndex=questions[index][2];
  const wrong=[...document.querySelectorAll(".answer")].filter((b,i)=>i!==correctIndex&&!b.disabled);
  wrong.slice(0,2).forEach(b=>{b.disabled=true;b.style.opacity=".3";b.textContent+=" — ตัดตัวเลือก";});
  scanActiveIndex=index;
  document.getElementById("feedback").textContent="วิเคราะห์แล้ว: ตัดตัวเลือกที่ไม่ถูกต้องออก 2 ข้อ (มีผลกับข้อนี้เท่านั้น)";
 }else if(type==="boost"){
  time=Math.min(60,time+10);document.getElementById("time").textContent=time;
  document.getElementById("feedback").textContent="เร่งพลังสำเร็จ! เพิ่มเวลา 10 วินาที";
 }else if(type==="heal"){
  if(lives>=maxLives)return;lives=Math.min(maxLives,lives+1);
  document.getElementById("hp").innerHTML=renderHP();
  document.getElementById("feedback").textContent="ฟื้นฟูพลังชีวิต +1 HP";
 }
 skillUses[type]=(skillUses[type]||0)+1;updateSkillButtons();saveGame();
}

function answer(choice){
 if(answered)return;
 answered=true;
 lastChoice=choice;
 clearInterval(timer);
 let q=questions[index];
 let buttons=[...document.querySelectorAll(".answer")];

 buttons.forEach((b,i)=>{
  b.disabled=true;
  if(i===q[2])b.classList.add("correct");
  if(i===choice&&choice!==q[2])b.classList.add("wrong");
 });

 if(choice===q[2]){
  playActorAnimation("playerActor","attack",600);
  playActorAnimation("enemyActor","hurt",520);
  correct++;
  let multiplier=getDifficultyInfo().multiplier;
  if(activeFloorPerk==="power")multiplier*=1.25;
  let gained=Math.round((10+Math.ceil(time/4))*multiplier);
  score+=gained;
  document.getElementById("feedback").textContent="ถูกต้อง! +"+gained+" คะแนน";
 }else{
  playActorAnimation("enemyActor","attack",600);
  playActorAnimation("playerActor","hurt",520);
  lives=Math.max(0,lives-1);
  document.getElementById("feedback").textContent=choice===-1?"หมดเวลา!":"คำตอบไม่ถูกต้อง";
  if(!friendMode) recordKnowledgeMistake(q,choice);
 }
 document.getElementById("score").textContent=score;
 const enemyBar=document.getElementById("enemyBar"); if(enemyBar)enemyBar.style.width=Math.max(0,100-((index+(choice===q[2]?1:0))/9)*100)+"%";
 document.getElementById("hp").innerHTML=renderHP();
 document.getElementById("next").classList.remove("hidden");
 updateSkillButtons();
 document.getElementById("next").innerHTML=(lives===0||index===8)?iconSvg("check")+" ดูผลลัพธ์":iconSvg("arrow")+" ข้อต่อไป";
 saveGame();
 if(choice===q[2]){
  document.getElementById("feedback").textContent+=" • กำลังโหลดคำถามถัดไป...";
  correctAdvanceTimer=setTimeout(()=>{if(answered)nextQuestion();},900);
 }
}

function nextQuestion(){
 clearTimeout(correctAdvanceTimer);
 if(!answered)return;
 if(lives===0||index===8){
  finish();
  return;
 }
 index++;
 scanActiveIndex=-1;
 answered=false; lastChoice=null;
 renderQuestion();
}

function finish(){
 clearInterval(timer);clearTimeout(correctAdvanceTimer);clearInterval(perkTimer);

 if(friendMode){
  friendScores.push({name:friendPlayers[friendTurn],score,correct});
  if(friendTurn===0){
   friendTurn=1;
   alert("ส่งเครื่องให้ "+friendPlayers[1]+" เล่นได้เลย");
   beginTurn();
   return;
  }
  let a=friendScores[0],b=friendScores[1];
  document.getElementById("resultTitle").textContent=
   a.score===b.score?"เสมอกัน":a.score>b.score?a.name+" ชนะ!":b.name+" ชนะ!";
  document.getElementById("resultText").innerHTML=
   `${a.name}: ${a.score} คะแนน (${a.correct}/9)<br>${b.name}: ${b.score} คะแนน (${b.correct}/9)`;
  document.getElementById("resultScore").textContent=Math.max(a.score,b.score);
  document.getElementById("resultXP").textContent="โหมดเพื่อน";
  document.getElementById("resultCorrect").textContent=a.correct+"/"+b.correct;
  friendMode=false;
  show("result");
  return;
 }

 let won=correct>=5;
 let xp=won?score+30:Math.floor(score/2);
 let stars=won?Math.max(1,Math.floor(score/2)):0;

 data.xp+=xp;
 data.stars+=stars;

 if(won&&!data.cleared.includes(currentStage)){
  data.cleared.push(currentStage);
 }
 data.unlocked=Math.max(data.unlocked,Math.min(stages.length,data.cleared.length+1));

 persist();
 update();
 updateDifficultyDisplay();

 document.getElementById("resultTitle").textContent=won?(currentStage===stages.length-1?"พิชิตยอดหอคอยสำเร็จ!":"ผ่านชั้นสำเร็จ!"):"ลองอีกครั้ง";
 document.getElementById("resultText").textContent=
 `ได้รับ ${stars} ดาว • แรงก์ ${rank().name}`+(won?` • ความยากเพิ่มเป็นระดับ ${getDifficultyInfo().level}`:``);
 document.getElementById("resultScore").textContent=score;
 document.getElementById("resultXP").textContent="+"+xp;
 document.getElementById("resultCorrect").textContent=correct+"/9";
 show("result");
 if(won && currentStage===0 && currentStage<stages.length-1){
  // ชั้น 1: ผ่านแล้วขึ้นชั้น 2 อัตโนมัติ โดยเลือกสกิลเริ่มต้นให้
  clearInterval(perkTimer);
  document.getElementById("perkPanel").classList.add("hidden");
  selectedPerk="time";
  floorPerk="time";
  document.getElementById("resultText").textContent += " • กำลังเข้าสู่ชั้น 2 อัตโนมัติ...";
  persist();
  setTimeout(()=>{
   if(currentStage===0){
    currentStage=1;
    beginTurn();
   }
  },1200);
 }
 else if(won && currentStage<stages.length-1){startPerkSelection();}
 else {document.getElementById("perkPanel").classList.add("hidden");floorPerk=null;}
}

function startPerkSelection(){
 clearInterval(perkTimer);selectedPerk=null;perkSeconds=35;
 const panel=document.getElementById("perkPanel");panel.classList.remove("hidden");
 document.getElementById("perkCountdown").textContent=perkSeconds;
 document.getElementById("perkChosen").textContent="ยังไม่ได้เลือกสกิล";
 document.getElementById("continueTower").disabled=true;
 document.querySelectorAll(".perk-option").forEach(b=>b.classList.remove("selected"));
 perkTimer=setInterval(()=>{
  perkSeconds--;document.getElementById("perkCountdown").textContent=perkSeconds;
  if(perkSeconds<=0){clearInterval(perkTimer);if(!selectedPerk)selectedPerk="time";applySelectedPerk();continueTower();}
 },1000);
}
function choosePerk(type){
 if(!["time","vitality","power"].includes(type))return;
 selectedPerk=type;
 document.querySelectorAll(".perk-option").forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle("selected",b.dataset.perk===type));
 const names={time:"พลังเร่งเวลา",vitality:"พลังชีวิตพิเศษ",power:"พลังคะแนน"};
 document.getElementById("perkChosen").textContent="เลือกแล้ว: "+names[type];
 document.getElementById("continueTower").disabled=false;
}
function applySelectedPerk(){
 if(!selectedPerk)return;
 floorPerk=selectedPerk;
 const names={time:"พลังเร่งเวลา",vitality:"พลังชีวิตพิเศษ",power:"พลังคะแนน"};
 document.getElementById("perkChosen").textContent="ได้รับ "+names[selectedPerk]+" สำหรับชั้นถัดไป";
}
function continueTower(){
 if(!selectedPerk)return;
 clearInterval(perkTimer);applySelectedPerk();
 const next=currentStage+1;
 if(next>=stages.length){mapScreen();return;}
 currentStage=next;beginTurn();
}

function quitGame(){
 clearInterval(timer);clearTimeout(correctAdvanceTimer);clearInterval(perkTimer);
 friendMode=false;
 persist();
 mapScreen();
}

function friendGame(){
 let a=prompt("ชื่อผู้เล่นคนที่ 1","ผู้เล่น 1");
 if(!a)return;
 let b=prompt("ชื่อผู้เล่นคนที่ 2","ผู้เล่น 2");
 if(!b)return;
 if(a.trim().toLowerCase()===b.trim().toLowerCase()){
  alert("ใช้ชื่อที่แตกต่างกัน");
  return;
 }
 let st=Number(prompt("เลือกชั้น 1-50","1"));
 if(st<1||st>TOTAL_FLOORS||!Number.isInteger(st))return;
 friendMode=true;
 friendPlayers=[a.trim(),b.trim()];
 friendScores=[];
 friendTurn=0;
 currentStage=st-1;
 beginTurn();
}

function leaderboard(){
 clearInterval(timer);
 let list=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("techLeaderboard")||"[]");
 let found=list.find(x=>x.name===data.name);
 if(found){
  found.xp=data.xp;found.stars=data.stars;found.rank=rank().name;
 }else{
  list.push({name:data.name,xp:data.xp,stars:data.stars,rank:rank().name});
 }
 localStorage.setItem("techLeaderboard",JSON.stringify(list));
 list.sort((a,b)=>b.xp-a.xp);
 leaderboardData=list;
 saveGame();
 document.getElementById("leaderRows").innerHTML=list.slice(0,10).map((x,i)=>
 `<tr><td>${i+1}</td><td>${x.name}</td><td>${x.rank}</td><td>${x.xp}</td></tr>`
 ).join("");
 show("rankboard");
}

function resetGame(){
 if(!confirm("ต้องการรีเซ็ตความคืบหน้าหรือไม่?"))return;
 data={name:"นักสำรวจ",xp:0,stars:0,unlocked:1,cleared:[],knowledge:[]};
 SAVE_KEYS.forEach(k=>{try{localStorage.removeItem(k);}catch{}});
 persist();
 update();
 homeScreen();
}

let knowledgeTab="all";
function escapeKnowledge(value){return String(value??"").replace(/[&<>"']/g,ch=>({"&":"&amp;","<":"&lt;",">":"&gt;",'"':"&quot;","'":"&#39;"}[ch]));}
function classifyKnowledge(question){
 const q=String(question).toLowerCase();
 if(/ไวรัส|มัลแวร์|รหัสผ่าน|ฟิชชิง|phishing|ความปลอดภัย|firewall|ไฟร์วอลล์|แฮก/.test(q))return "ความปลอดภัยไซเบอร์";
 if(/ปัญญาประดิษฐ์|\bai\b|machine learning|deep learning|แชตบอต/.test(q))return "AI";
 if(/html|css|javascript|python|โปรแกรม|อัลกอริทึม|algorithm|loop|ตัวแปร|debug/.test(q))return "การเขียนโปรแกรม";
 if(/อินเทอร์เน็ต|internet|เว็บไซต์|เว็บ|url|wifi|wi-fi|เครือข่าย|network|browser|เบราว์เซอร์/.test(q))return "อินเทอร์เน็ต";
 if(/cpu|ram|rom|ฮาร์ดแวร์|ซอฟต์แวร์|คอมพิวเตอร์|หน่วยความจำ|ระบบปฏิบัติการ/.test(q))return "คอมพิวเตอร์";
 return "เทคโนโลยีทั่วไป";
}
function recordKnowledgeMistake(q,choice){
 if(!Array.isArray(data.knowledge))data.knowledge=[];
 const question=String(q[0]||"");
 const correctAnswer=String(q[1][q[2]]||"");
 const selectedAnswer=choice>=0?String(q[1][choice]||""):("หมดเวลา");
 let item=data.knowledge.find(x=>x.question===question);
 if(item){item.wrongCount=(item.wrongCount||1)+1;item.selectedAnswer=selectedAnswer;item.reviewed=false;item.lastWrongAt=Date.now();}
 else {
  const category=classifyKnowledge(question);
  const hints={"คอมพิวเตอร์":"ทบทวนหน้าที่ของอุปกรณ์และส่วนประกอบคอมพิวเตอร์แต่ละชนิด","อินเทอร์เน็ต":"ทบทวนการเชื่อมต่อเครือข่ายและการทำงานของบริการบนเว็บ","ความปลอดภัยไซเบอร์":"ทบทวนวิธีป้องกันข้อมูลส่วนตัวและสังเกตความเสี่ยงออนไลน์","AI":"ทบทวนหลักการทำงานและข้อจำกัดของปัญญาประดิษฐ์","การเขียนโปรแกรม":"ทบทวนแนวคิดการเขียนคำสั่งและลำดับขั้นตอนแก้ปัญหา","เทคโนโลยีทั่วไป":"ทบทวนความหมายและการใช้งานของเทคโนโลยีที่เกี่ยวข้อง"};
  data.knowledge.push({question,options:[...q[1]],correctAnswer,selectedAnswer,category,wrongCount:1,reviewed:false,lastWrongAt:Date.now(),explanation:"คำตอบที่ถูกต้องคือ “"+correctAnswer+"” "+(hints[category]||hints["เทคโนโลยีทั่วไป"])+" แล้วลองกลับมาทำโจทย์อีกครั้ง"});
 }
 saveGame();
}
function knowledgeScreen(){
 clearInterval(timer);clearTimeout(correctAdvanceTimer);clearInterval(perkTimer);
 previousScreen=document.querySelector(".screen.active")?.id||"home";
 show("knowledge");
 document.getElementById("knowledgeSearch").value="";
 document.getElementById("knowledgeCategory").value="ทั้งหมด";
 knowledgeTab="all";
 renderKnowledge();
}
function setKnowledgeTab(tab){knowledgeTab=tab;renderKnowledge();}
function markKnowledgeReviewed(i){
 if(!data.knowledge||!data.knowledge[i])return;
 data.knowledge[i].reviewed=true;saveGame();renderKnowledge();
}
function renderKnowledge(){
 const list=document.getElementById("knowledgeList");if(!list)return;
 const mistakes=Array.isArray(data.knowledge)?data.knowledge:[];
 const reviewed=mistakes.filter(x=>x.reviewed).length;
 document.getElementById("knowledgeTotal").textContent=knowledgeLessons.length;
 document.getElementById("knowledgeMistakes").textContent=mistakes.length;
 document.getElementById("knowledgeReviewed").textContent=reviewed;
 document.getElementById("knowledgeTabAll").classList.toggle("main",knowledgeTab==="all");
 document.getElementById("knowledgeTabWrong").classList.toggle("main",knowledgeTab==="wrong");
 const term=(document.getElementById("knowledgeSearch").value||"").trim().toLowerCase();
 const category=document.getElementById("knowledgeCategory").value;
 let html="";
 if(knowledgeTab==="all"){
  const rows=knowledgeLessons.map((x,i)=>({...x,_i:i})).filter(x=>(category==="ทั้งหมด"||x.category===category)&&(!term||[x.title,x.body,x.example,x.category].join(" ").toLowerCase().includes(term)));
  html+=`<h3 class="section-title">${iconSvg("book",18)} บทเรียนความรู้ (${rows.length})</h3>`;
  html+=rows.map(x=>`<article class="knowledge-card"><span class="knowledge-tag">${iconSvg(categoryIcon(x.category),14)} ${escapeKnowledge(x.category)}</span><h3>${escapeKnowledge(x.title)}</h3><p>${escapeKnowledge(x.body)}</p><p class="knowledge-muted">ตัวอย่าง: ${escapeKnowledge(x.example)}</p></article>`).join("");
 }else{
  const rows=mistakes.map((x,i)=>({...x,_i:i})).filter(x=>(category==="ทั้งหมด"||x.category===category)&&(!term||[x.question,x.correctAnswer,x.selectedAnswer,x.category].join(" ").toLowerCase().includes(term)));
  html+=`<h3 class="section-title">${iconSvg("check",18)} คำถามที่เคยตอบผิด (${rows.length})</h3>`;
  html+=rows.length?rows.map(x=>`<article class="knowledge-card"><span class="knowledge-tag">${escapeKnowledge(x.category||"เทคโนโลยีทั่วไป")}</span> <span class="knowledge-tag">ตอบผิด ${Number(x.wrongCount)||1} ครั้ง</span><h3>${escapeKnowledge(x.question)}</h3><p>คำตอบที่เลือก: <span class="wrong-answer">${escapeKnowledge(x.selectedAnswer||"หมดเวลา")}</span></p><p>คำตอบที่ถูกต้อง: <span class="knowledge-answer">${escapeKnowledge(x.correctAnswer)}</span></p><p class="knowledge-muted">${escapeKnowledge(x.explanation||"ทบทวนคำตอบที่ถูกต้องและทำความเข้าใจแนวคิดของคำถาม")}</p><div class="knowledge-actions"><button onclick="markKnowledgeReviewed(${x._i})">${x.reviewed?" ทบทวนแล้ว":"ทำเครื่องหมายว่าทบทวนแล้ว"}</button></div></article>`).join(""):`<div class="knowledge-card"><h3>ยังไม่มีคำถามที่ตอบผิด</h3><p>เมื่อเล่นเกมแล้วตอบผิด ระบบจะบันทึกคำถามไว้ที่นี่เพื่อให้กลับมาทบทวน</p></div>`;
 }
 if(!html.includes("knowledge-card")&&!html.includes("ยังไม่มี"))html+='<p class="knowledge-muted">ไม่พบข้อมูลที่ตรงกับคำค้นหา</p>';
 list.innerHTML=html;
}

function manualSave(){
 const ok=saveGame();
 const el=document.getElementById("saveStatus"); if(el)el.textContent=ok?"บันทึกเกมเรียบร้อยแล้ว":"บันทึกไม่สำเร็จ กรุณาตรวจสอบพื้นที่จัดเก็บ";
}
function exportSave(){
 saveGame(); const found=loadBestSave(); const best=found&&found.envelope;
 if(!best){alert("ยังไม่มีข้อมูลสำหรับส่งออก");return;}
 const blob=new Blob([JSON.stringify(best,null,2)],{type:"application/json"});
 const url=URL.createObjectURL(blob); const a=document.createElement("a");
 a.href=url;a.download="TECH_QUEST_SAVE.json";document.body.appendChild(a);a.click();a.remove();
 setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(url),1000);
}
function importSave(event){
 const file=event.target.files&&event.target.files[0]; if(!file)return;
 const reader=new FileReader(); reader.onload=()=>{
  try{const e=JSON.parse(reader.result);if(!validEnvelope(e))throw new Error("invalid");
   localStorage.setItem(SAVE_KEYS[0],JSON.stringify(e));
   localStorage.setItem(SAVE_KEYS[2],JSON.stringify(e));
   loadGame();update();alert("นำเข้าข้อมูลสำเร็จ เกมจะโหลดข้อมูลที่นำเข้าแล้ว");location.reload();
  }catch{alert("ไฟล์ Save ไม่ถูกต้องหรือเสียหาย");}
 };reader.readAsText(file);event.target.value="";
}

// ===== LOCAL DEMO ACCOUNT SYSTEM =====
// This is a front-end demo only. Use a real server/auth provider for production.
const AUTH_USERS_KEY="techQuestAccounts_v1";
const AUTH_SESSION_KEY="techQuestSession_v1";
function readAuthUsers(){
 try{const value=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(AUTH_USERS_KEY)||"[]");return Array.isArray(value)?value:[];}
 catch{return [];}
}
function switchAuth(mode){
 document.getElementById("loginForm").classList.toggle("active",mode==="login");
 document.getElementById("signupForm").classList.toggle("active",mode==="signup");
 document.getElementById("loginMessage").textContent="";
 document.getElementById("signupMessage").textContent="";
}
function authEnter(user){
 localStorage.setItem(AUTH_SESSION_KEY,JSON.stringify({email:user.email}));
 if(user.name)data.name=user.name;
 update();
 show("home");
}
function registerAccount(){
 const name=document.getElementById("signupName").value.trim();
 const email=document.getElementById("signupEmail").value.trim().toLowerCase();
 const password=document.getElementById("signupPassword").value;
 const confirm=document.getElementById("signupConfirm").value;
 const msg=document.getElementById("signupMessage");
 msg.classList.remove("ok");
 if(name.length<2){msg.textContent="ชื่อผู้เล่นต้องมีอย่างน้อย 2 ตัวอักษร";return;}
 if(!/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(email)){msg.textContent="กรุณากรอกอีเมลให้ถูกต้อง";return;}
 if(password.length<6){msg.textContent="รหัสผ่านต้องมีอย่างน้อย 6 ตัวอักษร";return;}
 if(password!==confirm){msg.textContent="รหัสผ่านทั้งสองช่องไม่ตรงกัน";return;}
 const users=readAuthUsers();
 if(users.some(u=>u.email===email)){msg.textContent="อีเมลนี้มีบัญชีแล้ว กรุณาเข้าสู่ระบบ";return;}
 const user={name,email,password};
 users.push(user);
 try{localStorage.setItem(AUTH_USERS_KEY,JSON.stringify(users));}
 catch{msg.textContent="บันทึกบัญชีไม่ได้ พื้นที่จัดเก็บอาจเต็ม";return;}
 msg.textContent="สมัครบัญชีสำเร็จ กำลังเข้าสู่ระบบ...";
 msg.classList.add("ok");
 authEnter(user);
}
function loginAccount(){
 const identity=document.getElementById("loginIdentity").value.trim().toLowerCase();
 const password=document.getElementById("loginPassword").value;
 const msg=document.getElementById("loginMessage");
 const user=readAuthUsers().find(u=>(u.email===identity||u.name.toLowerCase()===identity)&&u.password===password);
 if(!user){msg.textContent="ชื่อบัญชี อีเมล หรือรหัสผ่านไม่ถูกต้อง";return;}
 authEnter(user);
}
function logoutAccount(){
 if(!confirm("ต้องการออกจากระบบหรือไม่?"))return;
 localStorage.removeItem(AUTH_SESSION_KEY);
 show("authScreen");
 switchAuth("login");
}
function restoreAuthSession(){
 try{
  const session=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(AUTH_SESSION_KEY)||"null");
  if(!session||!session.email)return null;
  return readAuthUsers().find(u=>u.email===session.email)||null;
 }catch{return null;}
}


document.querySelectorAll("[data-icon]").forEach(el=>{el.innerHTML=iconSvg(el.dataset.icon,20);});

const hadSave=loadGame();
update();
const signedInUser=restoreAuthSession();
if(!signedInUser){
 show("authScreen");
}else{
 if(signedInUser.name)data.name=signedInUser.name;
 update();
 if(hadSave && questions.length===9 && data.unlocked>0 && restoreSessionTime!==null){
  show("game");
  renderQuestion();
  if(!answered) document.getElementById("feedback").textContent="กู้คืนเกมแล้ว เลือกคำตอบเพื่อเล่นต่อ";
 }else{show("home");}
}
</script>
